label: Doctor's tip · Dairy
head: Does milk do
a body good?
name: Dr. Neal Barnard
end_cta: Find Dr. Neal Barnard on|Vegans Explore

captions.text: I don't think it does any body good.
It doesn't do your body good, but I gotta tell you,
it doesn't do the cow's body any good.
Cows don't make milk until they've been impregnated and given birth.
And they're impregnated in a not very nice way on the farm.
And when they give birth, their calves are taken away,
because if the calves drink the milk, there's nothing left to sell.
So the male calves are all killed for veal.
So the dairy industry is a meat industry.
Every dairy cow turned into low-grade hamburger.
They were artificially inseminated, separated from their offspring
over and over again until they were killed.
